item.title: ELF Format: Part 2
item.description:
ELF Format: Segments and Program Header Table

After understanding the ELF Header, the next critical component is the Program Header Table. This table describes segments - the portions of the file that will be loaded into memory when the program executes.

item.title: ELF Format: Part 1
item.description:
ELF Format: ELF Header

What is ELF?

ELF (Executable and Linkable Format) is the standard binary format used by Unix-like systems (Linux, BSD, etc.) for:

  • Executable files (a.out, /bin/ls)
  • Object files (.o)
  • Shared libraries (.so)
  • Core dumps
